baseline.equivalence_test: The frozen baseline arm calls the unchanged Generator.generate and explicitly reproduces the eval_rag_refactored DPR retrieval, Answer Scorer, QORE selector arguments including num_reads=100 and lam=2.0, evaluator metrics, seed, and max_new_tokens contract

core_invariants: Each question is retrieved and selected exactly once before any probe output exists.
All arms use the same selected QORE K=5 passages, model identity, deterministic decoding, and evaluator normalization.
Probe outputs never feed back into select_passages, retrieval, generation, or labels.
The existing Generator, selector, evaluator, and stable answer matcher are not modified.
Gold answers are used only inside the diagnostic oracle and never cross the compact exchange boundary.
Gold-answer copy is attempted only for selected-hit baseline EM failures whose combined oracle arm also fails.
Exchange output contains only question IDs, hit flags, arm scalar metrics, timing, and predeclared cohort metadata.

interfaces.input_schema: question, selected passage texts, and optionally deterministic gold-matched sentence or gold-answer oracle context
interfaces.output_schema: one scalar arm record with attempted, EM, F1, and generation time
invariants: The baseline probe is byte-equivalent to Generator.generate.
Extractive prompt changes only prompt instructions.
Oracle context is observation-only and has no selector access.

interfaces.input_schema: compact per-question hit flags and scalar arm records
interfaces.output_schema: cohort means, paired bootstrap deltas, exclusive failure attribution counts, and a dominant/mixed/insufficient gate
invariants: Primary attribution is restricted to selected-hit baseline EM errors.
No raw generation text is consumed or emitted by the combiner.
A follow-up is authorized only when one class exceeds both preregistered dominance thresholds.

plugins.insertion_point: after unchanged QORE selection and before metric aggregation
plugins.hypothesis: The current generation error rate is the reference against which diagnostic probes are compared.
plugins.input_schema: question and unchanged selected QORE K=5 passage texts
failure_signatures: model identity or decoding settings drift

plugins.insertion_point: same selected context, prompt construction only
plugins.hypothesis: Some selected-hit errors are answer extraction/format failures that a verbatim-span instruction can recover.
plugins.input_schema: question and unchanged selected QORE K=5 passage texts

plugins.insertion_point: selected-hit questions only, replace selected context with matched sentence windows
plugins.hypothesis: Some errors are caused by relevant evidence being buried among selected passages rather than absent.
plugins.input_schema: question and deterministic sentence windows containing a frozen lexical gold match
plugins.resource_estimate: one additional generation on selected-hit questions
failure_signatures: oracle sentence is emitted to exchange

plugins.insertion_point: adaptive diagnostic only after baseline and combined oracle EM failure
plugins.hypothesis: If the model can copy an explicit gold answer but cannot answer from a matched sentence, the lexical hit is not sufficient evidence for the question.
plugins.input_schema: question and one internal gold-answer candidate
plugins.output_schema: conditional gold-copy EM, F1, generation time
plugins.resource_estimate: at most one extra generation per unresolved selected-hit baseline error
failure_signatures: copy probe runs outside its adaptive condition

plugins.insertion_point: after all compact arm records are written
plugins.hypothesis: A dominant exclusive failure class can authorize at most one targeted follow-up.
plugins.input_schema: compact rows from all probe arms
plugins.output_schema: cohort summaries, paired bootstrap intervals, attribution, and gate decision
plugins.resource_estimate: scalar aggregation and paired bootstrap only
failure_signatures: small sample is treated as dominant

composition.merge_rule: The runner retrieves/selects once, executes independent observation arms, adaptively invokes copy only for unresolved selected-hit baseline EM errors, and the combiner consumes scalar records only.
interaction_ablations: baseline versus extractive prompt on identical selected context
baseline versus matched-sentence oracle on selected-hit questions
extractive prompt versus oracle context versus combined oracle
combined oracle failure versus conditional gold-answer copy

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic fixtures prove baseline invocation is unchanged and prompt probes cannot mutate selected passages or selector inputs.
tests: prompt, sentence extraction, and bootstrap replay
baseline, prompt, oracle, combined, and copy arms
attribution fixture for each failure class

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation[650:700], Wiki-DPR psgs_w100.nq.compressed, nprobe=64, one Top-50 DPR retrieval and one QORE K=5 selection with num_reads=100 and lam=2.0 per question
reproducibility.environment: runner records Python executable/version, git revision, config SHA-256, plugin tree hash, resolved generator identity/config hash, retrieval/selection settings, and output paths

limitations: A lexical answer match is not proof that a passage contains sufficient explanatory evidence.
The gold-answer copy arm is an oracle diagnostic and cannot support a production claim.
A 50-question fresh slice and one deterministic decoding seed cannot establish broad generalization.
All oracle outputs remain compact and no raw prompt, passage, answer, or prediction is exchanged.
A mixed or insufficient gate authorizes no intervention and requires more matched evidence.
